name: First State Fabrication
old_description: Custom Fabrications — Platforms, mezzanines, supports, and custom components built to specification.
about:
First State Fabrication has operated from Seaford, Delaware since its founding in 1926. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, producing stairs, railings, canopies, and custom components such as platforms, mezzanines, and supports. Processes include CNC plasma cutting, press braking, shearing, pipe and tube bending, rolling, sawing, certified welding, and in-house detailing with BIM. Equipment includes a 250-ton Accurpress press brake, Ercolina angle rolls and benders, Ellis and Marvel band saws, a Bend Tech Dragon CNC pipe and tube cutter, a 10-foot Betenbender shear, a Messer MetalMaster 5-by-10-foot CNC plasma table, and two Spydercranes (URW295 and URW547) for erection in confined spaces.

The company serves contractors, builders, and design teams across commercial construction, architectural metalwork, and industrial facilities such as wastewater treatment plants and chemical plants. Its ADA-compliant hand and guardrail systems meet IBC/ADA requirements, and its architectural steel assemblies are engineered for both decorative and functional performance.

First State Fabrication emphasizes shop-to-field accuracy, code-ready fabrication, and partnership through coordination, inspection, and on-schedule delivery. The firm also highlights its community roots in the Seaford area, supporting local organizations and events.
